remarks: Newly renovated 1 bedroom apartment (770 SQ. FT.) perfectly situated in the heart of downtown Stamford. Enjoy being just minutes away from the city's best restaurants, cafes, bars, theaters, parks, shops, fitness centers, the library, UConn Stamford, the commuter train, and more, all while tucked away on a quiet side street. This bright and spacious apartment features a brand-new kitchen with additional cabinetry in the dining area, an updated bathroom, new flooring throughout, and a large private balcony with beautiful downtown views. The bedroom offers generous space, plenty of natural light, and a large closet for comfortable everyday living. Enjoy the convenience of a secure 24-hour entrance and an inviting lobby with a comfortable seating area to welcome guests. Laundry facilities and extra storage, including bike storage, are conveniently located on the first level. Parking is available for rent at the Bedford Street Garage. Rent includes heat, gas, hot water, water, property management (trash collection & snow removal). No dogs allowed. The unit will be professionally cleaned prior to move-in. Available December 1, 2025.
